coverage.scope: Six configured deterministic business modules, not application-wide coverage

limits: Static generated-DDL/type comparison is not native PostgreSQL execution or hosted schema validation.
Next output tracing was inspected; this is not a hosted migration execution or a browser test.
Catalog/ledger reads do not validate indexes, foreign keys, defaults, type precision, collations, triggers or row contents.
The PostgreSQL orchestration tests use a mocked transport; generated DDL/type parity is not native PostgreSQL execution.
SQLite validates structure without a PostgreSQL migration ledger. Newer/unknown active PostgreSQL migrations are rejected intentionally.
No dependency installation, local server/browser, Docker launch, provider business call or hosted database write.
A future successful hosted health check will cover only the stated metadata contract, not authenticated workflows or the complete CI matrix.
